triples.subject: Perplexity-based GPT-2 filter
triples.source_sentence: We benchmark our approach against three representative baselines: • TF-IDF + Logistic Regression (LR): A traditional sparse feature-based classifier using TF-IDF vectors and a logistic regression model. This baseline serves as a lightweight, interpretable reference point. • RoBERTa fine-tuned classifier: A large transformer- based model pre-trained on general corpora and fine- tuned on the AI-GA dataset for binary classification. RoBERTa represents the standard in contextual deep text modeling. • Perplexity-based GPT-2 filter: An unsupervised method where the average GPT-2 perplexity of each abstract is computed. A threshold is applied to classify texts as AI-generated or human-written based on their likelihood scores.
